comment: Preserved C setup continuation, still before AD_SAMU. read.c creates an awake hostile Wizard; the first m.-forced rest gives it movement because allmain.c runs movemon() before replenishing movement. Its first action in the next forced turn uses a brown potion: C step 31 records tactics(wizard.c:413), distfleeck(monmove.c:538), and a More page, with no mattacku()/hitmu() call. The exact input and recording bytes are archived under .cache/B105-setup-miss-first-wizard-action.*.
